# pepeloper/ui

`pepeloper/ui` is a personal React component collection: shadcn base-rhea, Base UI, Tailwind CSS 4 and TypeScript.

- /docs: quick setup.
- /docs/{name}: preview, installation, usage, API and source.
- /DESIGN.md: shared visual and interaction rules for consuming apps.
- /r/registry.json: registry index.
- /r/{name}.json: installable source.

Install with `npx shadcn@latest add <REGISTRY_ORIGIN>/r/button.json`.
Use the current server origin or NEXT_PUBLIC_REGISTRY_URL.

65 primitives in components/ui; page-header and empty-state in registry/default.
Use semantic tokens, preserve focus states and label controls. Use Base UI render composition for triggers. Connect demo actions to application handlers.

After source changes: npm run registry:build, npm run docs:check, npm run lint, npm run build.
